I saved the draft mail to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com). It gives the proposed 2027 Quarrendon Freight Lines rate of $2,356 a seat and says Anselm OK'd sharing it. Nothing has been sent; it's only a draft.

The per-seat rate is a finance figure, and Hollis isn't one of the people it can normally go to. Anselm is the CFO and can approve sharing it himself, so I took his message as that approval and didn't ask anyone else. Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth didn't need to approve the mail either.

I didn't check the $2,356 figure against the Quarrendon contract files. I used the number Anselm gave me, which came from Dana.

I've replied to Anselm in his DM saying the draft is saved and still needs to be sent.
